metadata.review_notes: Notes on verification findings or edge cases

scheme_name: Full Official Legal Title as Notified in Gazette
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
objective: Official preamble stating the legislative or administrative intent of the program.
exclusions: Units manufacturing products listed in the statutory negative list (tobacco, alcohol, etc.)
Existing units not undertaking verified technology upgrade or expansion

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Only Micro and Small enterprises qualify for this central capital subsidy.

evidence.exact_quote: The scheme covers Micro and Small Enterprises having valid Udyam Registration engaged in manufacturing.

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Units with non-performing asset (NPA) status or active default are barred by institutional lending guidelines.
eligibility_rules.ambiguity_notes: Restructured accounts undergoing resolution require explicit bank committee clearance.

evidence.exact_quote: Term loans sanctioned by Primary Lending Institutions must be standard assets with no overdue NPA history.

financial_conditions.parameter_name: Maximum Eligible Plant & Machinery Investment Ceiling

evidence.exact_quote: The ceiling on eligible loan amount for calculation of subsidy is ₹100 Lakh.

registration_requirements.verification_method: API verification via Udyam Certificate Number

prerequisites: Enterprise must possess an active Udyam Registration Certificate.
Term loan must be sanctioned by an approved Primary Lending Institution (PLI) via SIDBI/NABARD.
Commercial machine quotation must confirm new, first-hand technology.
required_documents: Audited Balance Sheets and P&L statements for the last 3 financial years
Bank Term Loan In-Principle Sanction Letter
Pro-forma Invoice and Technical Quotation for Machinery

evidence.exact_quote: Upfront capital subsidy of 15% shall be calculated on the eligible investment in plant and machinery up to a ceiling of ₹100 Lakh (Maximum Subsidy ₹15 Lakh).

possible_relationships.target_scheme_name: Gujarat Industrial Policy - Assistance to MSMEs
possible_relationships.description: Central CLCSS 15% subsidy stacks with Gujarat State 25% capital subsidy without GFR 230(1) conflict because state guidelines explicitly authorize top-up assistance.
possible_relationships.statutory_non_duplication_clause: Gujarat MSME Policy Resolution No. SSI-102020-Gujarat Section 12: 'Assistance under this resolution shall be over and above any central government subsidy received, subject to total subsidy not exceeding 75% of asset cost.'

evidence.issuing_authority: Government of Gujarat Industries & Mines Department
evidence.exact_quote: Assistance under this resolution shall be over and above any central government subsidy received.

application_process:
1. Enterprise prepares project report and obtains term loan sanction from PLI.
2. PLI uploads claim on the central online portal (clcss.dcmsme.gov.in).
3. Nodal Agency (SIDBI/NABARD) scrutinizes claim and disburses subsidy into beneficiary reserve loan account.
4. Subsidized machinery must be installed and held for a lock-in period of 3 years.

source_documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
source_documents.exact_quote: Guidelines for Implementation of Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme for Technology Upgradation of Micro and Small Enterprises.
